name: Set
body:
SET
CR 30

XP 6,881,200
CN Medium outsider (god)
Init +12; Senses blindsight 500 ft., darkvision 60 ft., true seeing; Perception +48

DEFENSE

AC 56, touch 37, flat-footed 48 (+19 armor, +8 Dex, +19 deflection)
hp 960 (40d10 +560)
Fort +44, Ref +30, Will + 37
DR 30/-; SR 41

OFFENSE

Speed 30ft. (20ft.)
Melee +10 legendary volcanic keen exsanguinating greataxe +69 (1d12+24+1d10 fire/19-20/X3)
Legendary Vital Strike +69 (9d12+25+1d10 fire/19-20/X3)
Ranged +10 legendary impaling keen volcanic anarcanic shortbow + 67 (1d6+1d10 fire/19-20/X3)
Special Attacks ancient foe
Domain Spells

9th–implosion, summon monster IX (DC 40)
8th–cloak of chaos, earthquake (DC 39)
7th–disintegrate, word of chaos (DC 38)
6th–animate objects, harm (DC 37)
5th–dispel law, shout (DC 36)
4th–chaos hammer, inflict critical wounds (DC 35)
3rd–magic circle against law, rage (DC 34)
2nd–align weapon, shatter (DC 33)
1st–protection from law, true strike (DC 32)
19/day–summon (any creatures, combined CR of 30 or less)

STATISTICS

Str 48, Dex 34, Con 34, Int 32, Wis 20, Cha 32 Base Atk +40; CMB +59; CMD +71
Feats Power Attack, Cleave, Deific Casting, Endurance, Furious Focus, Great Cleave, Great Fortitude, Greater Vital Strike, Improved Great Fortitude, Improved Iron Will, Improved Vital Strike, Iron Will, Legendary Endurance, Legendary Furious Focus, Legendary Magic, Legendary Vital Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Quick Draw, Toughness, Vital Strike
Skills Acrobatics +52, Bluff +51, Climb +59, Craft (weapons) +51, Diplomacy +51, Disguise +51, Escape Artist +52, Fly +55, Intimidate +54, Knowledge (history) +54, Knowledge (planes) +51, Knowledge (religion) +51, Perception +45, Sense Motive +45, Stealth +52, Spellcraft +51, Swim +59
SQ Deific Traits: King of Beasts, Lord of Storm and Skies, Plague Bringer, Shape Shifter

Deific Weaknesses: Antagonist

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aligned Strike (Su)

A deity’s natural weapons, as well as any weapons it wields, are treated as being aligned to both sides of the deity’s alignment and as being epic for the purpose of resolving damage reduction.

Domain Mastery (Sp)

Set possesses the Chaos and Destruction domains. He may use any domain powers and cast any spells associated with his domains at-will. Set counts as a 30th level cleric for the purposes of domain powers and casting spells.

Ancient Foe (Ex)

Set is especially adept at harming his greatest enemy and those who serve him. Set gains the antagonist deific weakness in addition to any other weaknesses he might possess. Set always does maximum damage when attacking with melee or ranged weapons and adds his divinity score to all damage he deals with such attacks. At the end of each of Set’s turns, any creature willingly working in service to Set’s antagonist (such as a cleric worshipping Set’s rival god) he has dealt hit point damage to in some way must make a DC 39 Fortitude save against L-damage or die.

Semi-Unlimited Wish (Sp)

The deity may cast unlimited wish once per day as a spell-like ability that does not require material components. The unlimited wish may only be in regards to something within the deity’s purview. A god of oceans could cause global draught or flooding, for instance, but could not produce any effect unrelated to oceans.

The Struggle Eternal (Ex)

Set is the embodiment of opposition. In the ancient stories of light clashing with darkness, it is he who ever rises up in an effort to usurp authority no matter how many times he might be struck down. Set adds his Charisma bonus to his saves and to the damage reduction provided by his divinity score. Additionally, should Set be reduced to zero or fewer hit points or if he is killed in some manner, he instantly reappears at a specific location of his own choice anywhere on the plane he is currently on. When he reappears in this way, his current hit points instantly increase by 50. The only ways to permanently destroy Set is to kill him with a weapon that has been bathed in the blood of a dying god (or some similarly rare and esoteric weapon) or by dealing the fatal blow with a critical hit that rolled a natural 20 for its attack roll to hit.

Vindictive Harm (Su)

Set lashes out with a wrathful gesture that forces the target creature to experience some of Set’s suffering. Once per round as an immediate reaction to a creature inflicting hitpoint damage on Set, Set may force the creature to make a DC 40 Fortitude save or take an equal amount of damage. This damage may not be reduced by immunities, resistances, damage reduction, or similar effects. Additionally, Set may use the nemesis blade true dweomer once per day without expending any material components. See Little Red Goblin Games’ Legendary Levels Magic for details on this true dweomer.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure triple standard, +10 glamered legendary celestial chainmail of heavy fortification, +10 legendary volcanic keen exsanguinating greataxe, +10 legendary impaling keen volcanic anarcanic shortbow

For every legendary lightning bolt, unbreakable sword, or deific fortress, there is a craftsman who built it. Artisans are the blacksmiths, artists, and engineers of the gods. Their creations are the finest of their kind. Their workshops are stocked with innumerable treasures, each of which would cost a kingdom to obtain and many of which possess the power to reclaim such a kingdom afterwards. Though rarely the first to be moved to violence, the armaments of Hephaestus and Wayland make their wielders more than a match for any mortal alive.
